name: avokado 洋ナシ形フィット電源ボタン
target: avokado E3 Edge Hub power input
shape: User-supplied pear outline with curved stem; no leaf or bite; flat face, not rounded fruit volume
finish: Fine brushed silver; grain direction aligned with enclosure
motion: Momentary physical press, inward only, returning flush
electricalBehavior: Preserve existing E3 normally-open dry-contact momentary power input; no new touch-only architecture
mechanicalArchitecture: Rigid flat face supported by a captive rear carrier
Stem integrated with supported face rather than cantilevered as a separate key
Guided inward actuation with return spring or selected switch return
Defined hard stop preventing load transfer beyond selected switch travel
Thin perimeter separation; dimensions after switch/material/tolerance selection
powerRouting: Device-local power-management input; does not require AI or satellite availability
verificationStatus: DESIGN_CHANGE_ONLY; render is not a manufactured prototype
acceptance: No part of the face or stem protrudes at rest across approved tolerance and operating conditions
Off-center and stem-area presses do not tilt, bind or stay engaged
Release returns reliably without sustained power assertion
Electrical input behaves as specified for selected hardware and OS
Power control remains reachable with AI and external networking unavailable
